verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
As high as the heavens are above the earth
As far as the waters cover all the seas
So high so great
Is the love You have for me
As far as the east is from the west
You've taken away my worthlessness
You've turned my shame into joyful praise

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Forever I will thank You for
The grace You've given me
I once was lost but now I'm found
You're everything I need
I worship You I live for You
You're all that I desire
And forever I will live to
Tell of Your unfailing love

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
God so loved the world
That He gave His only Son
That whoever believes in Him
Shall never die, but have eternal life

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
I believe
I believe
I believe
In the risen Son of God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We are unworthy slaves
We are saved by Your grace
We come and bow our knees
To the King of all kings

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
We are laid down lovers
We are laid down lovers
We are laid down lovers
All for Your name, Your glory and honor
